title: My Autumn Book
author: Wong Herbert Yee
status: Collecting user-provided book images; reader toggle not connected yet

pages.description: Opening spread: child looks through a window, with a leaf beneath the text.
Child runs downstairs past a cat; backpack, camera, notebook and pencil appear beside the text.

pages.opening_text: In a corner of the garden shed,
pages.description: Child observes a spider web in the garden shed; spider-web photograph and crickets appear beside the text.

pages.opening_text: A chilly wind blows. I zip my jacket.
pages.description: Child zips her jacket; a cicada photograph and a woodpecker on a tree illustrate the sounds of approaching autumn.
Child photographs a chipmunk beside a tree and fence; a squirrel photograph and acorns illustrate animals storing food for changing weather.

pages.opening_text: Caterpillar knows it’s time to cocoon.
pages.description: Child observes a caterpillar above three transformation illustrations; a blue jay sits at a hanging feeder as the child takes a photograph.
Child watches geese flying south in formation, then walks among trees with changing autumn leaves.
Dogwood, oak, ash, maple and aspen trees display crimson, rust brown, yellow, red and gold autumn foliage, with individual leaves beside the text.

pages.opening_text: Together they whisper and sway in the breeze,
pages.description: Autumn leaves and acorns surround the text; the child dances among trees as colorful leaves swirl to the ground.
Child searches for different leaves on the ground and in a tree, then runs past an adult raking autumn leaves into a pile beside paper bags.
